Group rides in Oregon

11 recurring group rides around Oregon: 5 social, 4 road, 2 mountain bike. 9 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Ride Safe PDX Thursdays in Portland — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Tuesday Night Rubber Mallet runs 19–20 mph average, 2–3 regroups.
